description: Rotamer scan of SDF-9 Arg225 and Glu171, and charge composition of the phosphate-binding site versus PTP1B
code:
import requests, numpy as np, json
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
H={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}
AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def parse(txt,chain=None):
    res={};het=[]
    for L in txt.split('\n'):
        if len(L)<54: continue
        rec=L[:6]
        if rec not in ('ATOM  ','HETATM') or L[16] not in (' ','A'): continue
        rn=L[17:20].strip(); ch=L[21]; nm=L[12:16].strip()
        if len(L)>=78 and L[76:78].strip()=='H': continue
        x=np.array([float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54])])
        b=float(L[60:66]) if len(L)>=66 and L[60:66].strip() else 0.
        if chain and ch!=chain: continue
        if rec=='ATOM  ' and rn in AA3:
            k=int(L[22:26])
            if k not in res: res[k]={'rn':rn,'atoms':{},'b':b}
            res[k]['atoms'][nm]=x
            if nm=='CA': res[k]['b']=b
        elif rec=='HETATM' and rn!='HOH': het.append((ch,rn,int(L[22:26]),nm,x))
    return dict(res=res,het=het)
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc=P.mean(0);qc=Q.mean(0);V,S,Wt=np.linalg.svd((P-pc).T@(Q-qc))
    return V@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@Wt))])@Wt,pc,qc
AF=parse(requests.get('https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-G5EGA9-F1-model_v6.pdb',headers=H,timeout=120).text)
PY=parse(requests.get('https://files.rcsb.org/download/1PTY.pdb',headers=H,timeout=120).text,chain='A')
rS,rP=AF['res'],PY['res']
bb=['N','CA','C','O']
P=np.array([rP[i]['atoms'][a] for i in range(212,225) for a in bb])
S=np.array([rS[i]['atoms'][a] for i in range(220,233) for a in bb])
R,pc,qc=kabsch(S,P)
toS=lambda Y:(Y-qc)@R.T+pc            # PTP1B frame -> SDF-9 frame
ptrS=np.array([toS(h[4]) for h in PY['het'] if h[1]=='PTR' and h[2]==323 and not h[3].startswith('H')])
print('pTyr heavy atoms mapped into SDF-9 frame:',ptrS.shape)

# ---------- rotamer scan: can R225 / E171 swing out of the pTyr site? ----------
CHAINS={'ARG':['CB','CG','CD','NE','CZ','NH1','NH2'],'GLU':['CB','CG','CD','OE1','OE2']}
AXES={'ARG':[('CA','CB',1),('CB','CG',2),('CG','CD',3),('CD','NE',4)],
      'GLU':[('CA','CB',1),('CB','CG',2),('CG','CD',3)]}
def rot(axis_a,axis_b,ang,pts):
    k=(axis_b-axis_a); k=k/np.linalg.norm(k); c,s=np.cos(ang),np.sin(ang)
    v=pts-axis_b
    return axis_b + v*c + np.cross(k,v)*s + np.outer(v@k,k)*(1-c)
def scan(resid, nsteps=12, clash_lig=3.0, clash_prot=3.0):
    rv=rS[resid]; rn=rv['rn']; names=CHAINS[rn]
    base={n:rv['atoms'][n].copy() for n in names}
    # environment: all heavy atoms except this residue and the immediate backbone neighbours' side chains
    env=[]
    for ri,r2 in rS.items():
        if ri==resid: continue
        for nm,x in r2['atoms'].items():
            if abs(ri-resid)<=1 and nm not in ('N','CA','C','O'): continue
            env.append(x)
    env=np.array(env)
    CA=rv['atoms']['CA']; 
    angs=np.linspace(0,2*np.pi,nsteps,endpoint=False)
    ok_free=0; ok_any=0; tot=0; best=None
    chis=AXES[rn]
    import itertools
    for combo in itertools.product(angs,repeat=len(chis)):
        pos={n:base[n].copy() for n in names}
        for (a,b,start),ang in zip(chis,combo):
            A=pos[a] if a in pos else rv['atoms'][a]; B=pos[b]
            mv=names[start:]
            arr=np.array([pos[n] for n in mv])
            arr=rot(A,B,ang,arr)
            for n,x in zip(mv,arr): pos[n]=x
        X=np.array([pos[n] for n in names])
        tot+=1
        dprot=np.linalg.norm(env[None,:,:]-X[:,None,:],axis=2).min()
        if dprot<clash_prot: continue      # internally impossible rotamer
        ok_any+=1
        dlig=np.linalg.norm(ptrS[None,:,:]-X[:,None,:],axis=2).min()
        if dlig>=clash_lig:
            ok_free+=1
            if best is None or dlig>best[0]: best=(dlig,combo)
    return tot,ok_any,ok_free,best
for resid in (225,171):
    tot,ok_any,ok_free,best=scan(resid)
    rn=rS[resid]['rn']
    print(f'{rn}{resid}: {tot} rotamers scanned, {ok_any} sterically allowed in the apo model, '
          f'{ok_free} of those also clear of pTyr ({100*ok_free/max(ok_any,1):.1f}% of allowed)')
    if best: print('   best clearance from pTyr %.2f A'%best[0])

# ---------- electrostatic character of the pocket lining ----------
PHOS=[h[4] for h in PY['het'] if h[1]=='PTR' and h[2]==323 and h[3]=='P'][0]
def lining(res,frame_shift=None,label=''):
    pos=neg=0; names=[]
    for ri,rv in res.items():
        if ri==323: continue
        for nm,x in rv['atoms'].items():
            xx=x if frame_shift is None else frame_shift(x)
            if np.linalg.norm(xx-PHOS)<10.0:
                if rv['rn'] in ('ARG','LYS') and nm in ('NH1','NH2','NE','NZ'):
                    pos+=1; names.append(rv['rn']+str(ri)); break
                if rv['rn'] in ('ASP','GLU') and nm in ('OD1','OD2','OE1','OE2'):
                    neg+=1; names.append(rv['rn']+str(ri)); break
    return pos,neg,names
toP=lambda X:(X-pc)@R+qc
pP,nP,lP=lining(rP)
pS,nS,lS=lining(rS,toP)
print(f'\nCharged side chains within 10 A of the substrate phosphate:')
print(f'  PTP1B : {pP} cationic, {nP} anionic, net {pP-nP}   {sorted(lP)}')
print(f'  SDF-9 : {pS} cationic, {nS} anionic, net {pS-nS}   {sorted(lS)}')

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,4.2))
labs=['none','R225','R225+E171','all side chains']
sets=[set(),{225},{225,171},set(rS)]
MAIN={'N','CA','C','O','CB'}
def nclash(ts,cut=2.6):
    C=[]
    for ri,rv in rS.items():
        for nm,x in rv['atoms'].items():
            if ri in ts and nm not in MAIN: continue
            C.append(x)
    C=np.array(C)
    return int(sum(np.linalg.norm(C-p,axis=1).min()<cut for p in ptrS))
vals=[nclash(t) for t in sets]
ax[0].bar(labs,vals,color='firebrick'); ax[0].axhline(0,color='k')
ax[0].set_ylabel('pTyr heavy atoms clashing (<2.6 A)')
ax[0].set_title('SDF-9 occlusion is side-chain only')
ax[0].tick_params(axis='x',labelsize=8)
ax[1].bar(['PTP1B\ncationic','PTP1B\nanionic','SDF-9\ncationic','SDF-9\nanionic'],[pP,nP,pS,nS],
          color=['steelblue','firebrick','steelblue','firebrick'])
ax[1].set_ylabel('side chains within 10 A of substrate phosphate')
ax[1].set_title('Charge of the phosphate-site environment')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
